tagline: Navy-led white pages with a left title tick, pale blue-grey data cards, a bar chart in the navy-to-orange series and orange used only for the key figure.

palette.description: navy 60 percent, light blue 25 percent, orange under 10 percent

typography.style: system grotesque stack with bold numbers on pale cards

best_for: Formal, evidence-first decks with a chart and a source line on the key slide. Orange is reserved for the one number the audience must remember.
avoid_for: Playful or story-first talks; the structure is deliberately sober.
name: Consulting Navy
